records.title: Records
records.subtitle: Your prescriptions and lab reports, all in one place.
records.empty: No records yet. Upload a document to get started.

showDoctor.title: Show the doctor
showDoctor.subtitle: A print-ready summary of your health records.
showDoctor.disclaimer: Generated from your confirmed records. This is not a diagnostic tool; please discuss with a doctor.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: No records yet. Upload a prescription or lab report to get started.
dashboard.askDesc: Ask questions about your health records
dashboard.nextReviewBody: Check that the values were read correctly. It takes about a minute.
dashboard.nextCheckinBody: Log sleep, water and how you feel. Every field is optional.
dashboard.nextUploadBody: Take a photo of a prescription or lab report.
dashboard.nextDoneBody: Today's check-in is done. Before your next visit, open the doctor page.
dashboard.tourStep1: 1. See a value on the paper
dashboard.tourStep1Body: Open Records, pick Needs review, and tap a value. It lights up on the paper.
dashboard.tourStep2: 2. Watch Muse read a paper live
dashboard.tourStep2Body: In Records, tap Sample blood test. It is read on this device, then by Muse.
dashboard.tourStep3Body: Answers come only from your records and show their sources.
dashboard.tourStep4Body: A print-ready page with values as written and the lab's own ranges.
dashboard.switchDemoBody: You're using sample data. Switch to a different recovering or healthy story.

redflag.title: This may need urgent care

redflag.en: This may need urgent care. In Bangladesh call 999 or go to the nearest hospital.

chart.missingDays: No check-in on {{count}} of the last 30 days. Those days are left blank, not counted as zero.

landing.headline: Your doctor's paper, in words you can read.
landing.sub: MediSathi reads prescriptions and lab reports, checks every number against the paper with you, and explains them in simple Bangla or English. It never diagnoses or prescribes.
landing.note: Opens Rahima's sample records. Made-up data, no sign-up.
landing.error: The demo didn't start. Please try again.
landing.calloutBody: Below the range printed on this paper. Worth asking your doctor about.
landing.step1Body: Your phone reads the paper on the device. It is also sent to Meta's AI, Muse Spark, which reads it too. The code compares the two.
landing.step2Body: Tap a value and it lights up on the paper. Nothing is saved until you've looked.
landing.step3Body: Ask questions answered from your own records, with sources, then print a page for your doctor.
